messages.subject: CEO Office role at Oleria
messages.body:
Hi Jagadeesh,

Your post about the CEO Office role describes strategy and executive business operations run alongside you. That is close to how I worked at Ola Electric, where I partnered with the CEO and COO on fulfilment operations and owned finished goods inventory end to end.

Two results from that year: a stock-and-sell program on a Rs 200 Cr inventory buffer that took serviceability to 70% across India, and working capital cut by 40% in 2.5 months through S&OP planning. I do not have an MBA. I am an IIT Guwahati engineer who has done this kind of work for a year.

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Shlok
messages.hook: His own post hiring for the CEO Office: strategy and executive business operations, MBA preferred

messages.subject: Chief of Staff, Manufacturing (Chennai)
messages.body:
Hi Rajalakshmi,

Your post for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Manufacturing in Chennai lists plant performance and business reviews, which is the work I did at Ola Electric. I owned S&OP production planning there, built 3-month rolling production plans, and drove backend production planning for the 4680 cell line, where yield rose from 42% to 67% in two months.

I have about 1.3 years of full-time experience, so if your client needs someone more senior, a quick no is useful. If not, I would like to be considered. Could you tell me what you need from me to take it forward?

Shlok
messages.hook: Her post for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Manufacturing in Chennai: plant performance and business reviews

messages.subject: Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail
messages.body:
Hi Carbon Trail team,

A LinkedIn jobs roundup listed a remote Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail. I could not find the listing on your site, so I am writing directly.

A fashion brand's footprint is largely decided in its supply chain and inventory, which is where I spent the last year. At Ola Electric I ran S&OP planning over Rs 200 Cr of inventory and led a pan-India rebalancing of non-moving stock that unlocked 27% working capital.

If the role is open, I would like to be considered. Could you point me to the right person or the listing?

Shlok
messages.hook: A LinkedIn jobs roundup (Yash Chitransh, 3 Nov) listed a remote Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail; the listing itself was not found

messages.subject: Founder's Office Generalist at Leucine
messages.body:
Hi Vivek,

Leucine's line that pharma plants still run on paper, Excel and tribal knowledge matches what I saw inside a factory. At Ola Electric I implemented SAP MRP from scratch as Raw Material Manager, which cut stock-outs by 20%, and drove production planning for the 4680 cell line while yield went from 42% to 67% in two months.

Your Founder's Office Generalist role asks for someone who turns shop-floor realities into product requirements. My planning work sat between procurement, suppliers and production, so that translation is familiar.

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Shlok
messages.hook: Leucine's posting: pharma manufacturing still runs on paper, Excel and tribal knowledge; the role turns shop-floor realities into product requirements

messages.subject: Program Manager, Founder's Office at Sugar.fit
messages.body:
Hi Madan,

Sugar.fit's reported revenue grew 77% to Rs 66.5 crore in FY25. Growth at that pace tends to create more cross-functional projects than a leadership team can run itself, which is the gap your Program Manager, Founder's Office role describes.

That is the work I did at Ola Electric. I designed the Minimum Stock Limit program that moved the company from make-to-order to stock-and-sell and reached 70% serviceability across India, and I built the dispatch algorithm that cut Order-to-Delivery time from 32 to 14 days.

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Shlok
messages.hook: Reported FY25 revenue of Rs 66.5 crore, up 77% (January 2026, from registrar filings)

messages.subject: EA to COO | Shlok Agrawal
messages.body:
Hi Atrayee,

Your post is clear that the EA to the COO at WarpDrive is not an admin job: it means driving initiatives to closure, building dashboards and using AI tools every day. That is close to my last year at Ola Electric, where I partnered with the COO and CEO on fulfilment operations and owned finished goods inventory end to end. Before that, at InsuranceDekho, I built a Flask REST API with a Chrome extension that autofilled forms and cut response times by 40%.

I would like to be considered for the role in Jayanagar. Is there anything you need from me beyond the resume?

Shlok
messages.hook: WarpDrive's post says the EA to the COO is not an admin role: track initiatives to closure, build dashboards, use AI tools daily

messages.subject: Founder's Office BizOps at Helium Air
messages.body:
Hi Samiksha,

The BizOps hire at Helium Air will sit between manufacturing, warehouses and dispatch, tracking inventory and installation timelines for a new AC brand. That is the work I did at Ola Electric. I designed the Minimum Stock Limit program, moving from make-to-order to stock-and-sell with a Rs 200 Cr inventory buffer, and built a lotting algorithm for truck dispatches that cut Order-to-Delivery time from 32 to 14 days.

I would like to be considered for the role in Jaipur. Could you share this with the founders, or tell me who is running the search?

Shlok
messages.hook: Helium Air's BizOps hire coordinates manufacturing, logistics and warehouse partners and tracks inventory, dispatches and installation timelines
